How appeals work

  1. Sign in

    Use your college account.

  2. Open the citation

    Choose Appeal within 14 days.

  3. Tell us why

    Explain what happened and attach photos or documents.

  4. Get a decision

    We email you within 5 business days.

Possible outcomes

Cancelled

The citation is withdrawn and nothing is owed.

Reduced

The citation stands at a lower amount.

Upheld

The original citation and amount stand.

Questions

How long do I have to appeal?

14 days from the date the citation was issued. After that, the Appeal option closes.

Can I appeal more than once?

No. Each citation can be appealed once, so include all your evidence the first time.

I missed the 14 days. What now?

Contact the Campus Safety office; staff will explain your options.

How will I hear about the decision?

By email, and the citation status updates in the portal.
